** STANDARDIZED AVERAGE OF FED MANUFACTURING PRICES: NEW YORK, RICHMOND, KANSAS CITY, DALLAS, AND PHILADELPHIA.
*** STANDARDIZED AVERAGE OF MICHIGAN 1-YEAR, MICHIGAN 5-YEAR, AND NEW YORK FED CONSUMER INFLATION EXPECTATIONS.
SOURCE: INSTITUTE FOR SUPPLY MANAGEMENT (ISM), UNIVERSITY OF MICHIGAN, FEDERAL RESERVE BANK OF NEW YORK.
NOTES: SHADED AREAS INDICATE U.S. RECESSIONS AS DESIGNATED BY THE NBER.
